programme.desc: When her husband disappears, presumed dead, Neelam remarries. But then her husband miraculously reappears.

programme.title: An Evening in Paris
programme.desc: A wealthy woman (Sharmila Tagore) meets a charming but not completely truthful beau (Shammi Kapoor) in France.

programme.desc: A dutiful son sacrifices his happiness to live his father's dream of developing his native village and confronts the village troublemaker.
